summary: Market mood is risk-off and highly macro-driven, with elevated oil prices and rate-hike expectations pressuring gold and equities. Bitcoin has a bullish view from Michaël van de Poppe, but evidence for most requested altcoins and stocks is insufficient in the available same-day results, so they are classified as neutral rather than inferred.
